description: Header file defining the D3D11VP9Accelerator class for VP9 video decoding acceleration on Windows using Direct3D 11. It declares methods for creating VP9 pictures, submitting decode tasks, and managing frame context, as well as internal helpers for copying parameters and handling decoder buffers.

classes.name: D3D11VP9Accelerator
classes.description: A class that accelerates VP9 decoding on Windows using D3D11, managing frame submission, picture creation, and context handling.

methods.name: D3D11VP9Accelerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the accelerator with client, media log, video device, and video context.

methods.name: CreateVP9Picture
methods.description: Creates a new VP9 picture object.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Submits a VP9 picture for decoding with segmentation and loop filter parameters.

methods.name: GetFrameContext
methods.description: Retrieves the frame context for a VP9 picture.
